timestamp_clock: absolute perf_counter; client/server attribution requires the same host
prefix_cache: retained between repeats; warmup uses a different first token/prefix

metric_definitions.client: CPU-visible HTTP token receipt; TTFT starts at planned arrival
metric_definitions.model: server model-produced token timestamps; same planned arrivals and replay duration
metric_definitions.token_itl_s: Percentiles across all token intervals excluding first tokens
metric_definitions.goodput: Requests meeting TTFT and request-mean TPOT SLO per second
